mechanics.name: Benchmark alacrity recharge factor
mechanics.effect: Skills with recharge complete in 80% of their listed base recharge.

mechanics.name: Repeat Ransacker Skritt Swipe reduction
mechanics.trigger: Use an artifact while Repeat Ransacker is selected
mechanics.effect: Reduce the remaining recharge of Skritt Swipe by 2 seconds.

mechanics.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy utility recharge reduction
mechanics.trigger: Use Holo-Dancer Decoy, then use the next utility skill within 10 seconds
mechanics.effect: The next utility skill has 80% reduced recharge in PvE.

mechanics.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy effect duration
mechanics.effect: The utility-recharge modifier remains available for 10 seconds or until consumed.

mechanics.name: Chak Shield initiative refund
mechanics.trigger: Use Chak Shield, then use weapon skills that cost initiative during its effect
mechanics.effect: Qualifying weapon skills refund all initiative spent in PvE.

mechanics.name: Skritt Scuffle artifact interval
mechanics.trigger: Remain in range of the summoned skritt
mechanics.effect: The elite grants an artifact every interval for its duration.

limitations: Condition damage rows are aggregate Elite Insights outputs and are not assigned back to individual casts without combat-event evidence.
Enterprising Aristocrat now grants the verified PvE artifact-use initiative gain. Any remaining deficit is still exposed rather than invented.
Artifact use is replayed from observed casts. Hidden random grant timestamps remain external state inputs.
This build replays the benchmark timeline; it does not yet generate an optimized rotation from scratch.
